rules.rule: Candidate input carries no authority or physical truth. Authenticated transport supplies caller/world, and schema validity never grants authority.
Assistance requirements are disclosed only for KNOWN, authorized material evidence with FEASIBLE_AFTER_ASSISTANCE. Unsupported effects cannot carry a false material workaround.
A question cannot outlive its original root deadline. Its nested blocker must match that exact root, owner, generation, revision and budget context.
Storage permission decisions expire within two server ticks and must be freshly evaluated at effect time. DENY and UNKNOWN disclose no hidden target content.

Single chest/barrel bind one incarnation, double chest binds two distinct horizontally adjacent members in canonical (x,y,z,incarnation) order. Topology digest covers actual shape/type/orientation/members.
A resolved storage endpoint's storage ID, binding generation and caller scope must match its fresh access decision. Markers prove neither permission nor save-qualified custody.

COME captures one server position at acceptance. FOLLOW requires a current player ID and no captured destination. GO_NAMED_STORAGE requires one storage endpoint. Follow range, clocks and cumulative allowances are finite.

Delivery uses one default-component eligible item, quantity 1..64, distinct endpoints, one world/dimension, current withdrawal/deposit grants, and actual native deltas. Never infer credits from old stock.
LIVE_OBSERVED and JOURNAL_ACKNOWLEDGED are not participant saves or settlement. Higher checkpoint tiers require authenticated A references and exact original owner/effect correlation.

ActivityResumeSignal requests revalidation only. A alone checks current question/root/generation/authority/deadline, material feasibility, settled custody and cumulative allowance before continuation.

Canonical contract bytes: UTF-8, NFC strings, sorted object keys, compact separators, no floating numbers/duplicate keys/BOM, safe integer range, exactly one trailing LF. Semantic sets sort and deduplicate before encoding.
Registry labels and roles are metadata. Names are normalized NFC and casefolded for comparison without granting uniqueness across principals. Ambiguous visible matches clarify.

Unknown version/fields, malformed structures, unsupported storage, stale bindings and missing proof fail closed. Transport 1.0.0 is new proposal protocol, not an existing A Jobs/B planning schema change.
BRANCH_READY requires actual source/tree/JAR/docs/run/attempt and all owned gates. Explicit J-dependent cases remain blocked and never count as independent passes.

Role assignments map (world,beneficiary,role) to one storage UUID/generation without changing ownership or granting access. PUBLIC is not a beneficiary. A shared chest can serve multiple authorized citizens' defaults.

Container-type constraints apply to every storage selector. CHAT/COME/FOLLOW/STOP/STATUS cannot contain storage edits or delivery data. Unresolved action fields request clarification and never authorize effects.
